why: Hard-case lifecycle turns for Brama review: each family is the action its turns intend and the sentences a turn is written from. {title} is the active candidate's title, {new_title} and {new_title_lower} an unrelated candidate's title for a switch. The notification_negative family teaches that a subagent's completion report is not the user confirming completion, which finishGoal requires.
